{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
dtypes = trial_df.dtypes

# Check unique values in the 'disease_severity' column
# The column might have a different name
print("Available columns:", trial_df.columns.tolist())

# Check the distribution of disease severity
# Look for a column that might contain severity information
severity_columns = [col for col in trial_df.columns if 'sever' in col.lower() or 'level' in col.lower() or 'grade' in col.lower()]
print("Potential severity columns:", severity_columns)

# Print results
print("\nMissing values:\n", missing_values)
print("\nData types:\n", dtypes)"}
